record.label: Piecewise quadratic approximation and its error bound
record.statement: The circuit adds the linear term $|y|$ directly and approximates the remainder $\arcsin(|y|)-|y|$ with a quadratic on each interval.
record.boundary: The paper uses narrower polynomial intervals near $+1$, where the derivative of $\arcsin$ diverges. Lean relates the unsigned circuit arithmetic to the formula on each half-open interval in the proof table and checks the resulting error on the grid. The paper’s count of 440 refers to the intervals used to construct the polynomial approximation.
